title: Changelog & Updates
subtitle: Track the latest updates, feature releases, and bug fixes across all VibePress Studio products.

entries.version: v1.0.0 — Complete Product Documentation & Architecture Upgrade
changes: Updated Smart Affiliate Link Cloaker with complete enterprise documentation, technical architecture specs, and knowledge base.
Added Stripe Payment Link integration, Smart ToS Uncloaking for Amazon Associates, and DOM-Safe Keyword Auto-Linker.
Integrated dynamic UTM forwarding, conditional routing by OS/country/device/browser, and deal expiration scanner.

entries.version: v0.3.0 — Brand Redesign & Studio Lab Polish
changes: Integrated complete Google Stitch Design System with custom color tokens, Inter/JetBrains Mono typography, and responsive layouts.
Renamed top navigation menu from 'Marketplace' to 'Studio' and migrated page route from /pricing to /lab.
Added SVG brand logo to Header, Mobile Drawer, and Footer, along with modern vector favicon (icon.svg).
Fixed primary button and tab text contrast ensuring full WCAG AAA compliance.
Added support for 307 temporary redirects and iFrame masking.
Full compatibility with WordPress 6.0+ and PHP 8.0+.
